title: Harlem Run: Monday Night Run
description: Free, inclusive pacer-led runs and walks through Harlem, starting and ending at Marcus Garvey Park. Paces from 7 to 12 minutes per mile plus run/walk and walk groups; open to all ages and abilities, with bag drop available. Repeats every Monday through June 2027.
venue: Marcus Garvey Park, south side of Pelham Fritz Recreation Center, W 122nd St and Mount Morris Park West
fit_reason: A free weekly group run in Harlem with pacers for every pace - a standing Monday-night habit that costs nothing.

title: Foundations of AI & Responsible Use
description: A free, beginner-friendly NYPL Career Services class on how artificial intelligence works: core AI concepts, practical applications, ethical considerations, and best practices for safe daily use. This session meets in person at the Schomburg Center's American Negro Theater.
venue: Schomburg Center for Research in Black Culture, American Negro Theater
fit_reason: A free AI-literacy class right in Harlem at the Schomburg Center - his AI interest at zero cost and minimal travel.

title: Queens Night Market
description: New York City's flagship night market takes over the grounds outside the New York Hall of Science in Flushing Meadows Corona Park with over 100 international food and merchandise vendors, live performers, and a rotating weekly lineup. Runs Saturdays, 4 PM until midnight, through October 31.
venue: New York Hall of Science, Flushing Meadows Corona Park
fit_reason: Dozens of international food stalls and performances in one Queens park on a Saturday night.

title: NewFest38 Closing Night: The Man I Love
description: The closing-night film and party of NewFest, New York's LGBTQ+ film festival: Ira Sachs' new film about a downtown actor living with AIDS in late-1980s New York City, starring Rami Malek.
fit_reason: The queer film festival's closing-night screening plus party - a queer night out built around a New York story.

title: Horror and Dark Literature Book Club: The October Country
description: An in-person adult discussion of Ray Bradbury’s The October Country, focused on horror and dark literature.
fit_reason: A free adult book-club night for horror, dark fantasy, and classic science fiction readers.

title: Forest Fitness at Fort Tryon Park
description: A free, year-round “Fitness at the Fort” exercise program meeting at the Heather Garden entrance on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays. The class mixes staircase climbing, stretching and strengthening work, tree identification, and forest bathing, and is structured so all fitness levels are accommodated. Led by instructor Nancy Bruning.
venue: Margaret Corbin Circle, Fort Tryon Park
fit_reason: A free recurring outdoor fitness class in Manhattan with stairs, walking, and stretching for all levels.

title: Village Halloween Parade
description: New York’s 53rd annual Village Halloween Parade, a free nighttime procession of thousands of costumed participants up Sixth Avenue through Greenwich Village, with giant puppets, marching bands, and dancers. This year’s theme is “Body & Soul,” led by a Firehorse puppet and Grand Marshal Joey Arias.
price_label: Free to watch and march; paid tickets for special access
fit_reason: A free, iconic downtown night parade - a strong match for his queer nightlife and cultural-festival interests.

title: 53rd St Library Manga Book Club: The Summer Hikaru Died
description: An in-person adult manga book club at the 53rd Street Library discussing volume one of The Summer Hikaru Died, with the volume readable free through NYPL's Comics Plus database using a library card.
fit_reason: Free manga discussion at a Midtown library branch, with the volume readable through the library's comics database.

title: Tech Connect: Open Lab at Woodstock Library
description: A free drop-in computer lab hour for adults at the Woodstock Library: practice typing and mouse skills or get help with any computer task or project, with library laptops available and tech items to borrow afterward. No registration needed.
fit_reason: Free, no-registration computer lab time at a public library branch, part of NYPL's TechConnect program.

title: MoMI Halloween Party
description: The Museum of the Moving Image's annual free Halloween bash, part of its Open Worlds program: DJ, Magic Lantern performances, raffle prizes, refreshments for purchase, and members' early entry with Dark Tours through the museum galleries.
fit_reason: A free costume-night museum party with a DJ, performances and late gallery access - Halloween nightlife without a cover.
